contexts.text: That the Lord then made war against and overcame all kinds of persuasions of falsity, which are... the Horites, etc. Treated of. AC 1673.

The Horites in their mount Seir () = the persuasions of falsity which are from the love of self... The Horites were they who dwelt in mount Seir, as is evident from ... and as by the Horites were represented those who are in persuasions of falsity... the like was represented by this, that the descendants of Esau drove out the Horites from mount Seir... ()...
Thus these Horites = the persuasions of falsity from the love of self. There are persuasions of falsity from the love of self, and persuasions of falsity from the love of the world...
The like was done with many nations in former times, by which like things were represented; as by the Horites, who were driven out of mount Seir by the descendants of Esau.
